issues.issue: Myrcene membrane permeability claim is based on older, contested research and may overstate current scientific consensus
issues.fix: Soften the claim to 'early research suggests' and note findings are preliminary or that human evidence is limited

issues.issue: Pinene's memory retention claim cited against Project CBD rather than a peer-reviewed source, reducing credibility of that specific claim
issues.fix: Cite an NCBI or Frontiers study directly for the pinene-alertness connection, or qualify it as anecdotal/preliminary

issues.issue: CBD range listed as less than 1% without a source citation inline; this is accurate but unverified by any cited reference
issues.fix: Add an inline citation from Leafly or Weedmaps for the CBD data point in the strain overview table

issues.issue: Onset time of 2-5 minutes for smoked cannabis is slightly optimistic; many pharmacokinetic sources cite 5-10 minutes for full onset awareness
issues.fix: Adjust onset range to '2-10 minutes' or '5-10 minutes' and cite a pharmacokinetic reference for accuracy

issues.issue: Meta description is 147 characters — within range but on the shorter end; could incorporate a mild CTA or differentiator
issues.fix: Expand to 155-160 characters by adding a phrase like 'Learn what makes GDP a dispensary favorite.' to fill the character window

issues.issue: No FAQ section or FAQ schema markup present; FAQ content would capture featured snippet and People Also Ask real estate
issues.fix: Add a '## Frequently Asked Questions' H2 section with 3-5 Q&A pairs targeting related searches like 'Is Granddaddy Purple good for sleep?' and 'How long do GDP effects last?'

issues.issue: Alt text on the image is descriptive but does not naturally include the exact target keyword phrase 'Granddaddy Purple strain effects'
issues.fix: Revise alt text to begin with 'Granddaddy Purple strain effects visible in...' to reinforce keyword signal for image search

issues.issue: No internal linking placeholders or suggestions for related content, which limits topical authority signals
issues.fix: Add 2-3 contextual internal link suggestions to related strain guides or cannabis education content within the article body

issues.issue: The 'Similar Strains' section lacks dosing or effect-comparison context, making it harder for readers to make an informed choice between strains
issues.fix: Add a one-line THC range or key differentiator for each comparable strain (e.g., 'Purple Kush — THC 17-22%, slightly more sedating with less euphoria') to increase actionability

issues.issue: No explicit beginner dosing recommendation with a concrete starting amount (e.g., one small puff or 2.5mg for edibles)
issues.fix: Add a brief 'Recommended Starting Dose' note in the side effects or conclusion section with specific guidance such as 'Start with one small inhalation or 2.5mg THC in edible form and wait 30 minutes before redosing'

issues.issue: The 'Strain Overview' table section uses bold text rather than an H2 heading, which breaks heading hierarchy and may confuse crawlers
issues.fix: Change 'Strain Overview' from bold paragraph text to a proper '## Strain Overview' H2 heading for consistent hierarchy

issues.issue: Leafly and Weedmaps are consumer-facing databases rather than peer-reviewed sources; while appropriate for strain data, they reduce the academic credibility weight of the source mix
issues.fix: This is acceptable for cannabis consumer content, but consider adding one additional peer-reviewed citation (e.g., a Journal of Cannabis Research study) to strengthen the research tier of the source mix

issues.issue: Total inline citations number 10, which meets the 8-12 target but several sections (Similar Strains, smell and appearance section) have zero citations
issues.fix: Add at least one citation to the appearance/aroma section and one to the Similar Strains section to distribute citation coverage more evenly
